name: postman-workspace
purpose: Optional Postman workspace/API metadata access when offline collection files are insufficient.
setup_steps: When a workspace requirement exists, select and pin a reviewed integration
Reference a least-privilege local credential and verify no secret values are returned or committed
health_check: MCP initialize and tools/list; no collection or API request is sent during installation
corrective_action: Keep this disabled unless a reviewed workspace requirement cannot be met from repository collection files.
permissions: Metadata reads by default; workspace mutation and collection execution are separately authorized.
